# Research Method References

This directory contains pinned third-party methods that help generate research
hypotheses. They are untrusted references and are not installed globally or
treated as validated signal providers.

Current supply-chain method references:

- `best-serenity-skill`: broad synthesis and report templates;
- `serenity-bottleneck-hunter`: focused bottleneck discovery workflow.

Their intake status and promotion gates are recorded in
`../incubator/serenity-methods.md`. Any production use must go through a
first-party wrapper, versioned artifacts, qmtq validation, and human approval.
